ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: Hints and Tips OBJECTIVE MARKERS AND TERRAIN FEATURES

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Many players choose to bring the narrative of their missions to life by positioning objective markers within exciting terrain features on the battlefield. When setting up terrain features, you can place them where an objective marker would be, so long as you can reposition that objective marker directly on top of that terrain feature and it lies flat, without overhanging any part of it. That objective marker should still be more than 1" away from all impassable parts of that terrain feature (such as the walls of a ruin) so that there is sufficient room for models to move around it.

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: If it is not possible to set up terrain features or objective markers in this way, and both players agree, you can nudge the positions of any terrain feature or objective marker so that these conditions are satisfied. Of course, the final position of an objective marker should still be as close as possible to the location indicated on your mission's deployment map, but if both players are happy to tweak the battlefield arrangement to forge a stronger narrative, you should feel free to do so.

ordered_items.label: caption
ordered_items.text: Defender's Deployment Zone The Defender must set up their army within this area.

ordered_items.label: caption
ordered_items.text: No Man's Land

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: Objective Markers

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: The region of the battlefield that is not within either player's deployment zone is known as No Man's Land.

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: The locations of objective markers on the battlefield are typically shown on the deployment map of the mission being played, and are represented by this icon.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: ONLY WAR

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: The time has come to prove your worth as the greatest commander in the galaxy! All that stands between you and ultimate glory is an opposing force bent upon your destruction. Destroy the enemy army and secure strategic sites littered across the battlefield while stopping your foe from doing likewise.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 1 MUSTER ARMIES

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: First, players will need to muster armies based on the battle size they have selected, as described on pages 55-56. This mission is designed for Incursion, Strike Force and Onslaught battle sizes.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 2 MISSION OBJECTIVES

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: CAPTURE AND CONTROL

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Progressive Objective

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Starting from the second battle round, at the end of each player's Command phase, the player whose turn it is scores 1 Victory point (VP) for each objective marker they control (to a maximum of 3VP per turn). Details of how to control objective markers can be found on page 58.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 3 CREATE THE BATTLEFIELD

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Players now create the battlefield and set up terrain features using the guidelines on pages 49-52. The minimum size of your battlefield depends on the battle size you have selected, as shown in the table below.

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Players must then alternate setting up objective markers on the battlefield, starting with whichever player wins a roll-off, until a total of four have been placed. Objective markers cannot be placed within 6" of any battlefield edge, or within 9" of any other objective markers.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 4 DETERMINE ATTACKER AND DEFENDER

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Players roll off and the winner is the Attacker - their opponent is the Defender.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 5 DECLARE BATTLE FORMATIONS

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: In the order stated below, both players now secretly note down:

ordered_items.label: list_item
ordered_items.text: ■ Which of their Leader units will start the battle attached (they must specify which Leader unit is attached to which Bodyguard unit).

ordered_items.label: list_item
ordered_items.text: ■ Which of their units will start the battle embarked within Transport models (they must specify which units are embarked within which models).

ordered_items.label: list_item
ordered_items.text: ■ Which of their units will start the battle in Reserves (including Strategic Reserves).

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: When both players have done so, they declare their selections to their opponent.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 6 DEPLOY ARMIES

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Players then alternate deploying their units, one at a time, starting with the Attacker. Models must be set up wholly within their controlling player's deployment zone. Continue setting up units until both players have set up all the units from their armies, or you have run out of room to set up more units. If one player has finished setting up their army, their opponent continues to set up the remaining units from their army.

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: If both players have units with abilities that allow them to be set up after both armies have deployed, the players must roll off after all other units have been set up and alternate setting up those units, starting with the winner.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 7 DETERMINE FIRST TURN

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Players should roll off again, and the winner takes the first turn.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 8 RESOLVE PRE-BATTLE RULES

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: Players now resolve any pre-battle rules their armies have.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 9 BEGIN THE BATTLE

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: The first battle round begins. Players continue to resolve battle rounds until the battle ends.

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 10 END THE BATTLE

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: The battle ends when all of the models in one player's army have been destroyed, or once the fifth battle round has ended (whichever comes first).

ordered_items.label: section_header
ordered_items.text: 11 DETERMINE VICTOR

ordered_items.label: text
ordered_items.text: If, at the end of the battle, one army has been destroyed, the player commanding the opposing army is the victor. Otherwise, the player with the most Victory points is the victor (in the case of a tie, the battle is a draw).
